name: csv-selection
text: 幫我把csv檔案裡的 priority 為1的 smart contract repo 都拉下來 從這個gitlab https://gitlab.example.com/team/contracts 裡面拉
review: CSV selects smart contract repositories with priority 1; GitLab supplies those selected repositories. Preserve both sources and the URL.

name: csv-negation
text: 根據 repos.csv 裡 priority 為 2 而且 archived 為 false 的項目，從 https://gitlab.example.com/team/contracts clone 對應的 repo，不要 clone 其他 repo。
review: Both priority 2 and archived false apply to repos.csv entries. Clone only matching repositories from the given URL.

name: mixed-mode
text: 我有時候也想直接打英文 但可以根據mode correct my grammar and give me more concrete sentense
review: The speaker wants to type English and receive grammar corrections and more specific wording based on the mode. Do not reverse speaker and recipient.

name: everyday-condition
text: 如果明天下雨就把週六的野餐改到週日，地點不變，先問 Alex 能不能來，不要直接取消。
review: Keep tomorrow relative. If it rains tomorrow, move the picnic from Saturday to Sunday at the same location; ask Alex first and do not cancel directly.

name: english-polish
text: Use repos.csv to find repos where priority is 1, then clone them from https://gitlab.example.com/team/contracts. Dont clone repos not in the csv.
review: Preserve CSV selection, priority 1, the URL and exclusion of repositories outside the CSV.

name: single-source
text: 幫我 clone https://gitlab.example.com/team/contracts 到 ~/Projects，先不要安裝依賴。
review: Clone the given URL into ~/Projects and do not install dependencies yet. Do not introduce CSV selection or filters.
